apache/shenyu.about: Java-native API gateway for service proxy, protocol conversion and API governance.
apache/shenyu.did: Bug fixes and reliability work across `admin` / `sdk` / `bootstrap` (instance heartbeats and cluster master election, Oracle compatibility, Netty event-loop lifecycle, SDK response handling), plus registry cleanup, dependency slimming and release notes. Currently working on plugin fault-tolerance eviction and K8s scaler wiring.

agentic-ai-java/argi.about: Agent Runtime and Graph Intelligence: a Java agent framework built on Spring AI, with a graph runtime, multi-agent workflows and visual administration.
agentic-ai-java/argi.did: The opt-in ToolCall argument-validation gate (local JSON Schema `$ref` expansion, resource limits), a unified tool-failure status contract, the AgentResult delivery contract with structured-output finalizer, and a fix for user-registered KeyStrategy loss during state cloning. Currently working on streaming delivery boundaries.
